annotations.title: Get State Mortgage Readiness, HFA DPA, Tax & Insurance Rules

description: Retrieves verified 2026 state mortgage readiness rulebooks for Texas (TX), Florida (FL), Colorado (CO), Georgia (GA), and North Carolina (NC), including HFA down payment assistance programs, 620-640 FICO and 43%-50% DTI overlays, MUD/Metro District/Save Our Homes property tax escrows, windstorm/condo SIRS rules, and state contract closing rules.

inputSchema.description: Retrieves verified 2026 state mortgage readiness rules, HFA down payment assistance overlays, property tax/MUD/Metro District PITI math, wind/hail insurance risks, and closing rules for TX, FL, CO, GA, and NC.

creditScore.description: Optional representative middle credit score to check against state HFA 620-640 FICO overlays.

grossMonthlyIncome.description: Optional gross monthly household income in USD to check state HFA 43%-50% DTI headroom.

homePrice.description: Optional target home purchase price in USD used to model state-specific monthly property tax and insurance PITI.

state.description: Target US state code or name: TX (Texas), FL (Florida), CO (Colorado), GA (Georgia), or NC (North Carolina).
